findings.fact: backfill_claim invokes identity discovery and pending refresh before resetting v_now, inserting/updating worker heartbeat, selecting and updating the claim.
findings.implication: A committed heartbeat and claim prove their same transaction passed that identity prelude. A failure in that same prelude would roll back the heartbeat/claim. This does not identify which later RPC failed, or exclude a separate subsequent failed claim attempt.

findings.fact: The worker directly calls backfill_material first for derive_daily after claim; it calls identity_material only after all material pages are acquired.
findings.implication: For the reported unchanged 90-second lease, lost claim acknowledgement or an uncommitted first material RPC is consistent. A successful first material transaction normally extends the lease to min(attempt_deadline, operation_start+120 seconds). Later identity/commit/verify failure is not established by this state.

findings.fact: backfill_delivery_dispatch_v2 handles status/verify/delivery/finalize/recover/maintain/plan-snapshot/seal, not claim or material.
findings.implication: Its delivery status aggregation and verify/finalization path cannot be assigned as the cause of a claim/first-material failure without evidence of a different operation.

findings.fact: The two observed D03 dependencies each hold one 32,006-byte page; the baseline RPC response bound is 64 MiB and timeout 15 seconds.
findings.implication: No response-size overflow is evidenced for these source pages. This is not a full HTTP envelope/transport proof.

findings.fact: Measured inner material selector custom 33.612 ms/generic 15.787 ms, D04 candidate custom 6.1 ms/generic 5.6 ms, D01 candidate 3.752 ms and exhaustion selector 0.085 ms were fast in the retained observations.
findings.implication: Those measurements do not cover outer authentication/global advisory lock, owned-row lock, material lease UPDATE, later has_more query, HTTP/connection failure or a different concurrent workload. No specific heavy selector is established.

unmeasured_identity_paths: Pending-discovery queue selection, then at most 128 distinct retained date/source pairs for one member, with exact ticker or composite/share-class matching and source metadata validation.
Pending-refresh queue selection, then at most 2 completed daily/cohort tasks in the installed claim prelude, followed by identity material build and queue updates.
next_safe_action: Deploy the separately qualified local operation/reason logging repair, retain the first useful failure classification, then select one exact bounded read-only diagnostic justified by that operation and current state.
conditional_readonly_rules: No authenticated business RPC or helper invocation that writes claims/leases/identity queues.
8-second statement and 3-second lock limits with explicit transaction read-only.
Source/hash guards and current exact workload parameters.
No FOR UPDATE/UPDATE/claim execution; no credentials, query payload or raw source bodies returned.
A selector-only result does not prove lock or end-to-end latency.
reason_no_probe: Current evidence supports an operation-classification gap, not a demonstrated heavy selector. Another broad selector sweep or performance rewrite would be speculative.
